events.headline: $150M Series F led by TPG Rise at $3.2B
events.description: Series F led by TPG Rise with participation from SoftBank, Leeds Illuminate, Accel, CPP Investments, CZI. Flat $3.2B post-money. Domicile flip Singapore->India announced. IPO scale target mentioned.

events.headline: $150M refinancing (MARS Growth + HSBC)
events.description: Up to $150M refinancing: $130M loan from MARS Growth Capital (up to $100M) + $20M credit line from HSBC (up to $50M). 4-year renewal.

events.headline: $650M Series E at $3.2B valuation
events.description: $650M ($430M primary + $220M secondary) led by Accel US and SoftBank Vision Fund II. Bertelsmann partial exit. Unicorn status achieved.

events.headline: $350M debt from CPP Investments
events.description: $350M debt financing from CPP Investments (CPPIB) to fund mergers and acquisitions globally. Emeritus estimated gross bookings of $500M for the financial year.

events.headline: iD Tech acquisition for $200M
events.description: Eruditus Group acquired Silicon Valley-based iD Tech for $200M cash. Expansion into K-12 STEM education.

events.description: Bertelsmann acquired a stake in Eruditus Executive Education as part of expansion in strategic growth region.

events.headline: IPO plans at least 2 years away; domicile flip to India
